rows.OpportunityName: NEW LS & IRR per 03.25.26 Plans - VE'd
rows.ProposalDescription1:
Qualifications

This proposal is based on plans prepared by: Land Design, sheets L1.00 thru L3.07, Dated: 3/25/2026

Landscape Install

This proposal reflects the plant schedule quantities shown on the plans. Shortages and undersized plant material are common in the landscaping industry due to current market conditions; therefore, height of shrubs per required container size cannot be guaranteed. This proposal may include increased container sizes to meet the requested specifications shown on the plant schedule. An add/deduct price can be provided for an additional cost. Multi-trunk Palm CT/GW/HT measurement based on the shortest truck. Mulch shall be PineStraw Bales (+10%) & Pine Bark Mulch 3 CF Bag (+10%) per schedule.

Material Availability

Red Cluster cultivar is not available. This proposal includes Weeping Bottlebrush as a substitution.

Foxtail Palm is only available up to 12-14’ oa.

Formosa Azalea is not available. It is suggested to substitute with generic assorted Azalea.

It is suggested to substitute with Gulf Coast Muhly Grass with Pink Muhly Grass.

Soil Samples & Amendments

Soil testing analysis results will determine if drainage sump gravel or amendments are necessary. Soil testing will be provided at no additional cost to the owner and/or developer. It is more cost effective to add sump gravel or amend soils with fertilizers and nutrients, should results show any deficiencies. These items can be provided for an additional price on “as needed” basis.

Sod Install

Sod shall be Bahia Sod (+15%) & Floratam Sod (+10%) per the schedule. Sod quantities are estimated. The actual quantity used may be different. The contractor may request additional areas for the sod to be installed at the same square foot price contracted through this scope of work. It is not a common industry practice to roll Bahia sod after installation. It can be provided at an additional price. A color-out attachment has been provided to show sod areas Juniper has included in this proposal.

Exclusions

This proposal does not include tree protection or soil remediation. Pavers to be provided by others.

Substitutions

This proposal includes Duckbill anchoring as a substitution for Duckbill anchoring. Fertilizer type is not specified; therefore, this proposal includes Agriform Tablets 20-10-5 as the Fertilizer. This project includes root barrier to protect the utility lines.


Irrigation Install 70%

Irrigation estimate is based on the PARTIAL/INCOMPLETE irrigation plans prepared by IDS, sheets IR-1.01 thru IR-1.13, Dated: February 05, 2026

Lateral lines not provided on irrigation plan. Lateral lines determined by Juniper formula.

Sleeving sizes not provided on irrigation plan. Sizes were estimated.

Water source has been determined and defined within the plans as Reclaimed 2” metered water source providing 130 GPM @ 79 PSI.

Juniper Landscaping shall not be liable for POC's ability to produce the volume of water required and/or the quality of water.

The irrigation price does not include the price of a backflow. Juniper does not install backflows. This should be installed by a certified plumber.

Power to irrigation controller to be provided by others.

All Landscape is hydro-zoned, Rotors, Sprays for turf & separate tree bubbler zones.

Pool deck is on separate zones and must be irrigated with potable water. Potable water to be provided by others.
